policies.name: Delegation of Authority Policy

evidence.name: Approval and Delegation Records
evidence.description: Approved delegations or authorization records demonstrating that the decision-maker was empowered to issue the decision.

requirements.source_summary: The Authority may request information or data from any licensee when it considers the information necessary for carrying out its functions. The licensee must provide the requested information or data within the period and through the mechanism specified by the Authority, and the Authority may use the information received to perform its functions.

todo.name: Manage and fulfill Authority information requests
todo.description: Create a controlled process to receive, assign, validate, approve, and submit requested information or data to the Authority within the specified period and through the specified mechanism.

policies.name: Regulatory Information Request Policy
policies.description: Define responsibilities and controls for responding to information and data requests from the Authority.

policies.name: Data Submission and Quality Policy
policies.description: Set requirements for validating the accuracy, completeness, and authorized submission of regulatory information.

documents.name: Regulatory Request Log
documents.description: Record each Authority request, required information, submission mechanism, due date, owner, and status.

documents.name: Regulatory Data Submission Procedure
documents.description: Describe the workflow for gathering, reviewing, approving, and submitting requested information.

evidence.name: Authority Request and Submission Records
evidence.description: Copies of requests and corresponding submissions showing the requested information, submission method, and dates.

evidence.name: Review and Approval Records
evidence.description: Evidence that submitted data was reviewed and approved before transmission.

requirements.source_summary: If a licensee cannot provide the requested information or data within the specified period or through the required mechanism, it must submit a response within the period set by the Authority explaining the reasons and including information or data that may meet the Authority's requirements. The Authority may accept the response and set an additional period for the requested information, or reject the reasons and require submission within the original or an additional period.

todo.name: Handle inability to meet regulatory data requests
todo.description: Implement an escalation process that submits a reasoned response and available alternative information to the Authority when a request cannot be fulfilled as specified, and tracks any resulting deadline or further requirement.

policies.name: Regulatory Deadline Exception Policy
policies.description: Define how inability to meet an Authority data request is identified, escalated, justified, and communicated.

policies.name: Regulatory Communications Policy
policies.description: Set approval and recordkeeping controls for formal responses to the Authority.

documents.name: Request Exception Response Template
documents.description: Provide a controlled format for explaining the impediment, identifying available information, and requesting or recording further instructions.

documents.name: Regulatory Request Escalation Log
documents.description: Track missed or at-risk deadlines, reasons, communications, Authority decisions, and revised due dates.

evidence.name: Reasoned Exception Responses
evidence.description: Copies of responses explaining why the requested information could not be provided as specified and identifying available information.

evidence.name: Authority Follow-up and Deadline Records
evidence.description: Correspondence or notices showing whether the response was accepted, rejected, or followed by an additional deadline.

requirements.source_summary: A person intending to perform preparatory work, including preparing plans or conducting studies, for an electricity activity requiring a licence or exemption may apply to the Authority for a permit before starting that preparatory work, using the form approved by the Authority.

todo.name: Obtain preparatory-work permits before starting covered work
todo.description: Identify preparatory activities associated with electricity activities requiring a licence or exemption, and submit the Authority-approved permit application before commencing those activities.

policies.name: Electricity Regulatory Approval Policy
policies.description: Require regulatory review and confirmation of any permit or approval needed before covered preparatory work begins.

policies.name: Project Regulatory Gate Policy
policies.description: Define a project gate preventing commencement of covered preparatory work until the applicable permit process is completed.

documents.name: Preparatory Work Permit Register

documents.name: Permit Application Package

evidence.description: Copies of applications submitted using the Authority-approved form before preparatory work began.

evidence.description: Issued permits or application decisions compared with documented preparatory-work commencement dates.

requirements.source_summary: A permit holder must comply with the conditions established by the Authority. Those conditions may include providing the Authority with information about completion and progress of preparatory work according to the Authority's mechanism, and notifying the Authority of changes to the proposed capacity of the permitted electricity activity and obtaining an amended permit when the Authority considers it necessary.

todo.name: Monitor permit conditions and report project changes
todo.description: Track preparatory-work progress and proposed capacity against permit conditions, submit required progress information, and notify the Authority of capacity changes and obtain an amended permit when required.

policies.name: Permit Compliance Policy
policies.description: Require responsible personnel to monitor and comply with conditions attached to preparatory-work permits.

policies.name: Project Change Control Policy
policies.description: Require regulatory assessment and notification of changes to the proposed capacity of a permitted electricity activity.

documents.name: Permit Conditions Compliance Register
documents.description: List each permit condition, assigned owner, required submission, status, and completion record.

documents.name: Capacity Change Register
documents.description: Record proposed capacity changes, notifications to the Authority, and any amended permits.

evidence.description: Information submitted to the Authority through the specified mechanism about completion and progress.

evidence.description: Records of reported capacity changes and any amended permits obtained from the Authority.

policies.name: Operational Readiness Approval Policy

documents.name: Pre-Commencement Checklist

evidence.name: Licence or Exemption Certificates

requirements.source_summary: A licensee wishing to relinquish its licence or transfer ownership of licensed assets, including by sale, pledge, or another means, must notify the Authority and provide requested information or data. It may not complete the transaction without the Authority's written approval, and the transaction is not considered concluded or effective without that approval. The Authority may approve with conditions, require the Council-set financial consideration for reviewing and deciding the application, or reject the request and transaction.

todo.description: إنشاء قائمة تحقق لإتاحة المستندات والمعلومات المطلوبة في المقرات والموقع الإلكتروني، مع ضبط النسخ والتحديثات والاستجابة لطلبات الحصول عليها.

policies.name: سياسة الإفصاح عن المعلومات التنظيمية
policies.description: تحدد متطلبات نشر التعريفة والأكواد والمعايير والأدلة وإجراءات الشكاوى والوثائق التنظيمية ذات الصلة.

policies.name: سياسة إدارة المحتوى المنشور

documents.name: قائمة تحقق متطلبات النشر
documents.description: قائمة بالمعلومات والوثائق المطلوب إتاحتها في المقرات والموقع الإلكتروني.

documents.name: سجل إصدارات المحتوى التنظيمي
documents.description: سجل للنسخ المنشورة وتواريخ التحديث والمراجعة والمسؤول عن اعتمادها.

documents.name: إجراء تزويد المستهلكين بالوثائق
documents.description: إجراء لتقديم نسخة التعريفة أو المعلومات المطلوبة عند الطلب وتوثيق الاستجابة.

evidence.name: لقطات أو أرشيف الموقع الإلكتروني

evidence.name: نسخ المستندات المتاحة في المقرات

evidence.name: سجلات طلبات المستهلكين والاستجابة

requirements.source_summary: تتولى الهيئة تنظيم نشاط الكهرباء وسوق الكهرباء، ولها اتخاذ التدابير اللازمة لإيقاف حالات الإخلال بالمنافسة وإزالة آثارها. وتحدد الهيئة الأسواق وخصائصها، والمشاركين فيها، وممارسات وترتيبات واتفاقيات وتصرفات الإضرار بالمنافسة والاستثناءات المبررة، ومعايير الوضع المهيمن والضوابط للحد من إساءة استخدامه والاستثناءات ذات الصلة.

todo.name: تقييم ممارسات السوق والحد من مخاطر الإخلال بالمنافسة
todo.description: إنشاء مراجعة موثقة للأنشطة والاتفاقيات والتصرفات ذات الصلة بالسوق، وتقييم مخاطر الممارسات الضارة بالمنافسة أو إساءة استخدام الوضع المهيمن وتصعيدها للمعالجة.

policies.name: سياسة المنافسة ومكافحة الممارسات الضارة
policies.description: تحدد الضوابط الداخلية لتقييم الاتفاقيات والممارسات التجارية وفق معايير المنافسة المطبقة.

policies.name: سياسة مراجعة الاتفاقيات التجارية
policies.description: تفرض مراجعة قانونية وتنظيمية للترتيبات والاتفاقيات التي قد تؤثر في المنافسة أو السوق.

documents.name: سجل الأسواق والمشاركين ذوي الصلة
documents.description: حصر داخلي للأسواق والأنشطة والأطراف ذات الصلة بنشاط المنشأة.

documents.name: سجل تقييم مخاطر المنافسة
documents.description: يوثق تقييم الممارسات والاتفاقيات ومخاطر الوضع المهيمن وإجراءات المعالجة.

documents.name: إجراء مراجعة الاتفاقيات والممارسات
documents.description: إجراء يوضح نقاط المراجعة والتصعيد والموافقة قبل تنفيذ الترتيبات ذات الصلة.

evidence.name: تقييمات المنافسة الموثقة
evidence.description: تحليلات ومراجعات للاتفاقيات أو الممارسات ذات الأثر المحتمل على المنافسة.

evidence.name: محاضر وموافقات المراجعة القانونية
evidence.description: سجلات المراجعة والموافقات والقرارات المتعلقة بالترتيبات التجارية.

evidence.name: سجل الإجراءات التصحيحية
evidence.description: ما يثبت معالجة المخاطر أو إيقاف أو تعديل الممارسة محل الملاحظة.

evidence.name: مواد التدريب أو التوعية
evidence.description: سجلات توعية الموظفين المعنيين بضوابط المنافسة والممارسات المحظورة.

documents.description: إجراءات منفصلة عند الحاجة لمعالجة خصائص فئات المستهلكين المختلفة.

documents.name: سجل شكاوى المستهلكين
documents.description: سجل للبلاغات والشكاوى وتصنيفها وإجراءات معالجتها ونتائجها.

evidence.description: عينات من سجل الشكاوى توضح الاستلام والتصنيف والمعالجة والإغلاق.

documents.name: سجل الأصول والعمليات المدارة
